function.name: dartfx_help
function.description: Provides detailed help, assistance, or guidance on a specific topic within the DartFX application. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

topic.description: The specific topic for which help is requested. Examples include 'trading', 'account_setup', or 'security'.

include_examples.description: Determines whether to include practical examples in the help response. Defaults to false.

language.description: The preferred language for the help content. Defaults to 'English'.
